steps.description: Establish high contrast keys, background spacing, and professional digital display typography layout.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle with compatible parameters
steps.description: Establish Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2 parameters alongside SDK targets.

steps.description: Create a sleek state selector drawable shape for numbers keys.

steps.description: Create state selector drawable shape for operator buttons (orange visual focus).

steps.title: Set up custom button resource btn_action.xml
steps.description: Create state selector drawable shape for auxiliary control functions like clear and bracket keys.

steps.title: Validate inputs, bracket counters, errors and outputs formatting

steps.description: Compile the app modules and resource layouts for a functional final APK.
